scope: Independent source/lifecycle review and actual compiled static readiness-method reflection only; no Android constructor, listener, ICE or media mocked or run by this regression. Runtime timer/media assertions remain separate.

red.finding: Malformed primary addresses hostname, invalid IPv4 and expanded unspecified IPv6 were accepted by the readiness gate. Retained actual compiled class and failed oracle show RED; pre-fix source was not separately captured before root fixed it.

requirements_confirmed: One existing SDK owner thread handles readiness, timer and publication.
Publication requires successful setLocalDescription, matching actual local description type, current nonempty description and nonclosed engine.
Relay-only path requires a usable component-1 UDP relay with canonical nonzero IPv4 and positive primary port. Related zero fields are permitted.
At most one 500 ms timer is armed after the first usable relay; elapsed state prevents rescheduling.
Timer publication rereads actual current SDK local description and readiness.
Direct path still requires ICE gathering COMPLETE.
Publication latch is set before main-thread callback; callback captures immutable exact SDP and remains closed guarded.
Publication cancels timer and full cleanup removes pending owner callbacks.
Offer/answer share the gate and late COMPLETE/candidate callbacks return after the latch.
Native SDP validation remains authoritative after durable commit; no new native schema, synthetic end-of-candidates, second setLocalDescription, trickle or ICE restart.
Existing setup and maximum-call deadlines are unchanged.
runtime_regressions_still_required: Actual timer fires while SDK ICE gathering remains in progress, with at least one usable relay.
Both caller offer and callee answer publish once, authenticate through native durable E2EE, and carry real media.
Late COMPLETE and candidate callbacks cause no second listener callback or mutated published SDP.
Close before timer expiry produces no stale description and no resources crossing into a new generation.
lifecycle_source_review.known_unchanged_physical_limitation: Restoring a previously selected communication device after physical unplug may return false; fallback route behavior is not physically tested.

boundary: No repository changes, signing, keystore/password access, Android/emulator controls, network listeners, deployment or rejected relay expiry/ACL actions.
